plugins.name: afk
plugins.description: AFK skill chain — design (incl. optional interactive UI prototyping via prototype, and optional verification design — UI journeys + API scenarios — via grill-verification + to-verification-plan) + executor (execute, interactive or driven) + hands-off driver (autopilot) + feature smoke gate (smoke-test, full or minimal) + code-learning artifact (understand — one self-contained interactive HTML explainer per feature, MR, or code area) + stakeholder demo script (to-demo-plan — a minute-budgeted beat-by-beat plan for demoing a delivered feature to POs and QA) for the AFK Jira/GitLab workflow. Design stages run interactively; the implementation middle runs hands-off via autopilot or by hand.
